findings.description: The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, so objects (including the uploaded vendor roster) are stored without an enforced default encryption policy using KMS or SSE.

No acl or bucket policy is declared and no public access block is configured, leaving access control to defaults; combined with the absence of any restriction this bucket holding report and vendor data risks unintended exposure.
No logging block is configured, so object-level access to this data bucket is not recorded to the audit_trail bucket, hindering detection of unauthorised access.
Versioning is disabled while force_destroy is true, so objects can be overwritten or destroyed with no recoverable prior version, permitting tampering or destruction of stored data.
The ledger export bucket declares no server_side_encryption_configuration, so financial export data is stored without enforced default SSE-KMS encryption.
No logging block is configured for this sensitive ledger bucket, so access to financial exports is not auditable.
Versioning is not enabled and force_destroy is true, so ledger export objects can be silently overwritten or deleted without recovery.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is set, so model artifacts are stored without an enforced default encryption configuration.

No server_side_encryption_configuration is set on the runbooks bucket; operational runbooks frequently contain sensitive procedural and credential-adjacent information and are stored unencrypted by default.
No logging block is configured, so reads and writes to the runbooks bucket are not logged to the audit trail bucket.

findings.issue_category: missing access logging on audit bucket
findings.description: The audit/log-delivery bucket itself has no access logging configured, so tampering with or exfiltration of the centralised log store would leave no independent trail.

A vendor roster spreadsheet (likely containing third-party PII/business data) is uploaded with no server_side_encryption or kms_key_id argument into a bucket that also lacks default encryption, so it is stored unencrypted.
